seo_description: Disco-funk score for a graduation animation film. Original composer dropped out a week before deadline. I wrote everything from scratch in 8 days.
hero.title: Ray Animation
hero.subtitle: Music Composition / Disco-Funk Score / DAE Howest Graduation Film
about.text: Disco-funk score for an animated film about a stone giant who wakes up in a cave and discovers dance. The original composer dropped out a week before the deadline. I stepped in and had 8 days to deliver everything: score, sound design, and final mix. I got the animatics, hand-placed sync markers in Pro Tools, and matched every beat to Ray's movements frame by frame. Three rounds of feedback with the animation team. Standing ovation at the cinema screening.
music.m1.title: Bass & Rhythm
music.m1.desc: Slap bass and electric drums, Chic and Earth Wind & Fire style. Every hit matched to Ray's movements frame by frame.
music.m2.title: Brass, Sax & Synths
music.m2.desc: Brass carries the melody. Saxophones add warmth. DJ scratches connect sections. Mixed in Pro Tools, mastered with Waves J37 tape saturation.
music.m3.title: Credits Version
music.m3.desc: Same theme, fuller arrangement. Gospel organs, live drums, Omnisphere synths. Approved on the first pass.
sync.s1.title: 8-Day Deadline
sync.s1.desc: Composer dropped out a week before screening. I took over the full score and sound design from scratch.
sync.s2.title: Frame-by-Frame Sync
sync.s2.desc: Hand-placed markers in Pro Tools to lock every musical hit to Ray's dance movements. Tempo changes follow the animation, not the other way around.
sync.s3.title: Three Feedback Rounds
sync.s3.desc: Worked directly with the animation team. Adjusted timing, arrangement, and mix between each round. Final version approved for cinema screening.
